en: The Wife of an Important Man
ov: زوجة رجل مهم هو فيلم مصري عُرض عام 1988، بطولة أحمد زكي وميرفت أمين. تأليف رؤوف توفيق وإخراج محمد خان. الفيلم تم اختياره في قائمة أفضل مئة فيلم في تاريخ السينما المصرية.
plotEn: When Mona marries the seemingly decent police officer Hisham, she finds out there is more into him than what he shows to the people. Mona's life turns into hell, as he deprives her of all worldly pleasures, not to mention his mistreatment of everyone around him, even his neighbors. The film documents many political, economic, and social events in the lives of this small family, in a dramatic and realistic atmosphere.
